notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (User-agent: * / Disallow only /gate/, /onex/, /cdn-cgi/, one hashed path) does not name any Claude UA and has no blanket Disallow, so tier (a)/(b)/(c) all permitted; no block encountered on any tier. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch of robots.txt + the category-sitemap index (gzip) worked, but the department product-listing pages are client-hydrated (Svelte islands) and the item-count element only renders after JS runs, so tier (b) Playwright/Chromium (headless, de-DE locale, domcontentloaded then wait for .reptile-item-count__item-count) was used for every leaf page load; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: union of (1) the 5 relevant department category-sitemaps fetched and gunzipped directly (sitemap_categories under otto.de/category-sitemap/), specifically heimtextilien (home textiles, 203 URLs), dekoration/aufbewahrung (storage/organization branch, 59 URLs), haushalt (household, storage-relevant subset: kuechenaufbewahrung + koch-backzubehoer/lebensmittelaufbewahrung + waeschepflege), and garten (garden storage branch); (2) cross-checked against each clean URL list to confirm no textile/storage node was missed. Every recorded leaf's rendered <h1> and <link rel=canonical> were checked against the requested slug; 0 canonical mismatches found across 187 leaf fetches (5 pages had a canonical-selector timeout only, h1 still confirmed the node). QTY: primary source is the rendered item-count header ('N Produkte', selector .reptile-item-count__item-count, data-item-count attribute) captured after full hydration. IMPORTANT QTY CAVEAT: exactly 100 of the 187 leaf pages checked (~53%) rendered the identical figure '500 Produkte' regardless of category breadth - from very niche nodes (e.g. ironing-board covers, headphone stands) to broad ones - while genuine large/small categories reported distinct non-round numbers throughout the range (e.g. 382, 733, 1685, 2427, 6516, 17843, 18663). This is not plausible as 100 independent true totals; it matches a known e-commerce search-backend pattern (a ranking/search-index total-hits cap or floor - the same pages also show OTTO's 'why are we showing you these products' ranking-transparency control, indicating these listings are served by the search/ranking layer rather than a strict category-taxonomy count). Per the anti-fabrication rule, qty was NOT recorded as 500 for these; each is left qty=null with flag='MANUAL REVIEW' and evidence noting the suspected cap, while the category classification itself (textile vs storage vs neither) is unaffected and kept at its assessed confidence. EXCLUDED: curtain/blind hardware (rods, rails, rings, hooks, tracks, weights, clips, spare parts under heimtextilien/gardinen/zubehoer and rollos-plissees/zubehoer) - hardware not textile; slatted bed frames (Lattenroste) and mattresses (Matratzen, excluding the mattress-protection/topper sub-branch which IS textile per rules) - furniture/bedding base, not textile coverings; sleeping bags (Schlafsaecke) - camping gear, not home textile; wallpaper (Tapeten, incl. photo/textured/door wallpaper) - wall covering, not textile; shower-curtain clips only (no standalone shower-curtain category page exists anywhere in the sitemap - checked heimtextilien/dekoration/haushalt/wohnen sitemaps for 'duschvorhang', only the clips sub-slug exists, so no shower-curtain row was recorded, and no URL was invented). Decorative/general-merchandise dekoration nodes (candles, vases, figurines, mirrors, wall clocks, artificial plants, Christmas/Easter decor, picture frames, planters, room dividers) were reviewed and excluded as neither textile nor storage per the Decorative-vs-Storage and Home-Accessories-Boundary rules. Kitchen/pantry items excluded as Kitchen & Dining not Storage: bread baskets for serving (Brotkoerbe under tischaccessoires), waste-paper baskets, rubber bands, ice-cube/appliance accessories. Clothes hangers (Kleiderbuegel) excluded as closet hardware/accessory, not a storage container itself (parallel to the curtain-rod hardware exclusion). Picnic baskets, contact-lens cases, piggy banks, cling-film/foil dispensers, and a beach-chair drink holder were reviewed under dekoration/aufbewahrung and excluded as personal-carry/dispensing/novelty items whose primary purpose is not home storage. Two additions beyond the initial mega-menu pass, confirmed present in the sitemap and added to storage_rows: Laundry Bags (haushalt/waeschepflege/waeschesammler/waeschetaschen - explicit rule-listed item, MEDIUM->HIGH), and Beeswax Food Wraps / Cereal Dispensers / Watch Winders / Bookends / Bicycle Wall Mounts / Headphone Stands (MEDIUM/LOW, storage-nav-placed accessory-adjacent items, function decides per ambiguity-resolution order). Textile vs Storage overlap check: no node qualified for both arrays; fabric-based storage items (Fabric Storage Bags/Boxes, Beeswax Wraps) were placed in storage_rows per storage.md Sec 25 (primary function is storage, not textile).
